name: popsicle
headline: G-Lock Double Opt-In Manager: WordPress Mailing
short_description: This mailing list management plugin allows the visitors of your blog subscribe to your mailing list using a double opt-in method. The plugin sends an email with the subscription confirmation link to the user and if the user confirms the subscription, it sends a welcome email to each new subscriber. The details of new subscribers are saved to the internal WordPress database. You can <a href="http://www.glockeasymail.com/wordpress-email-newsletter-plugin-for-double-opt-in-subscription/" title="cre
author: gartz

sections.overview:
The G-Lock Double Opt-in Manager is a WordPress plugin that enables blog visitors to subscribe to mailing lists using a double opt-in verification process. When a user subscribes, the plugin sends a confirmation email; once confirmed, it sends a welcome message and stores the subscriber's details in the WordPress database. The plugin supports customizable signup forms, email field merging for personalization, mailing list export, RSS-to-email newsletter conversion, and scheduled broadcasts. It works with standard WordPress mail settings or custom SMTP servers, making it ideal for bloggers and small business owners building permission-based email lists.
Build permission-based mailing lists with double opt-in verification
Convert blog RSS feeds into automated email newsletters for subscribers
Manage and export subscriber lists from WordPress for external email marketing tools
Customize signup forms with additional fields and personalized confirmation messages
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/gartz/G-Lock-Double-Opt-in-Manager--Wordpress-Plugin-`
1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
3. Search for 'G-Lock Double Opt-in Manager'.
4. Click 'Install Now' and then 'Activate'.
